item: Open-Meteo archive shape gets a dated pin and a registry entry
summary: 0.6 gate row A closes only when the AR6 and Open-Meteo lanes have registry entries; AR6 had one, Open-Meteo had only its SECURITY.md Weather row. OPENMETEO_AS_OF dates the archive request and answer shape (path, ALLOWED_DAILY names, timezone=UTC, daily.time and daily_units, the 1940 floor, the anomaly variables) as written from the published API documentation, not a live answer, and open-meteo-archive-shape registers it (upstream page, check step, CC BY 4.0, refresh, 18 months). No behaviour change.
